translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: HECHOS
book.title: An t’ajbilab ax in t’ajamal an abathualechic

content: Ts’at’ey a Timoteo c’al a Pablo ani a Silas
Ulitschic a Pablo ani a Silas ti bichou Derbe ani ti bichou Listra. Taja’ hua’ats jun i belom im bij Timoteo. Im mim pel i belom jaye ani pel i Israel, ani in tata pel i griego.
Uxnal ti lej alhua’ inic a Timoteo c’al an ebchalabchic ax ti bichou Listra ani ax ti bichou Iconio.

A Pablo in le’ tin junic a Timoteo. Oc’ox in ne’tha’ ca cojchin in inictal, cum ne’ets ca xe’tsinchic jun ti hua’ats i Israelchic ax in ujnam antsana’ ca cojchin. Patal an Israelchic taja’ in exla’its abal in tata a Timoteo pel i griego.

Tim patal am bichouchic jun ti xe’ets a Pablo ani a Silas ani a Timoteo in tsa’bichiquiyal an ebchalabchic. In olchixnanchal nixe’ xi uchbixtalab u axi ts’ejcanchat am belomchic axi yab Israel. Ja’its nixe’ an cau axi thuchnenec ti Jerusalén c’al an abathualechic ani c’al axi bijith ti eyalchic c’al an tamcunel ebchalab tihua’.
Ani lej tsaplilinchab in ichich an ebchalabchic quin lej tsapic bela’ an Ajatic. Chuthel chuthel ne’ets yanenel am belomchic.
U tsu’binchab a Pablo ejtil i huachbilab jun i inic ti Macedonia
An Espíritu Santo in c’anchichic a Pablo ani in junquilchic yab quin olnaxna’ in cahuintal a Dios ti pulic bichoulom Asia. Jaxtam ne’ets huat’et’el ti tsabal Frigia ani Galacia.
Taley ulitschic utat ti tsabal Misia. Taja’ in tsalpay ne’etsacchic ca c’ale ti tsaylel ti tsabal Bitinia, tocat c’anchin junil c’al an Espíritu Santo yab ca c’ale.
Jaxtam ne’ets huat’et’el utat ti tsabal Misia. Taley ulits ti bichou Troas tin hualchicte’lil am pulic lejem.
Taja’ tam acal a Pablo tsu’binchab ejtil i huachbilab. In tsu’u cubat jun i inic ti cau ti tsabal Macedonia. Lej lubath tauna a Pablo antse’: Quit chich teje’ ti Macedonia tucu tolmiy.
Cum antsana’ in tsu’uhuits a Pablo, thubat huahua’ u t’ojojlats cu c’ale ti Macedonia. I exla’its abal chubax a Dios tu canal cu c’ale taja’ qui olnanchi an alhua’ cau.
A Pablo ani a Silas ti bichou Filipos
Taley huahua’ u balinits al i tan ti Troas, ani u t’apith c’ale ti ts’aclath tsabal Samotracia. Tin aytal q’uicha u c’ale ti Neapolis.
Taja’ i jila’ an tan, ani u c’ale ti Filipos axi pel i bichou abatnab c’al an romanochic. Pel i bichou lej c’athpich in exbath ti pulic bichoulom Macedonia. Tats tu jilc’on huahua’ tsab ox a q’uicha.

Tam jun i sábado u cale huahua’ ti al am bichou, u c’ale hualchicte’lil am pulic itse’ jun tin ujnamchic ti ol an Israelchic. Tats tu quetle qui olnanchi in cahuintal a Dios an uxumchic axi tamcuthits taja’.

Jun jaja’chic im bij pel a Lidia. Pel i Tiatirajib ax u nujul c’al i toltom lej huinat alhua’. Cum in lej c’ac’nal a Dios tin ichich, in alhua’ bina’ in xutsun c’al in olnanchixtal a Pablo. Lej tolminchat c’al an Ajatic quin alhua’ pena’ tin ichich jahua’ in ats’al.

Taley tamna’ pujan, ani jaye patal axi tin q’uima’. Tam a Lidia tu lej ucha’ huahua’: ―Max tata’chic tin tsu’tal tin chubax belom c’al an Ajatic, huana tu q’uima’ ani quit jilc’onchic taja’ hue’. Expith c’al in lej pacabethomtal jun ejet chubax u c’ale.

Taley jun a q’uicha tam tu ne’etsits jun tin ujnam ca olonchic an inic, tameq’ui i tamu jun i ts’ic’ach co’oyab c’al i teneclab. Pel i calthom q’uijlab. Lej c’unat co’oyab c’al an thabalchic ani lej atlomnab c’al an tumin.

Tam nixe’ xi ts’ic’ach ts’at’ey c’al huahua’, tal tocat thajajal. In thajat ulunal: ―Axe’ xi inicchic in t’ojonchal am pulic Dios Pay’lom ti eb. Pelchic i olnom jant’ini’ ta ca jec’ontha an inicchic c’al an hualab.

Cum yantalam a q’uicha in huilq’uith t’ajal antsana’ an ts’ic’ach, a Pablo lej it’ixbethab. Tam huilq’uin quim met’a’, ani in ucha’ an teneclab axi c’al ti co’oyab an ts’ic’ach: ―Nan tu uchal tim bij a Jesucristo quit tixc’an c’al an ts’ic’ach. Tameq’ui t’ajat tixc’anits an teneclab.

Tam ti an thabalchic c’al an ts’ic’ach in tsu’uhuits abal yabats ne’ets quin ejtou quin atlomnaye c’al an tumin, tam in yac’ua’chic a Pablo ani a Silas ani in ne’tha’chic ti al am plaza jun ti c’uajat an oc’lecchic.
Im bina’chic c’al an ts’ejcom cauchic ani in ucha’chic: ―Axe’ xi inicchic pel i Israel. Xe’ets tu othnachiquinchal i bichohuil c’al yan i cau.
Tocat in exobchal in cuete’ ujnamtal. Cum huahua’ pel tu lej romanochic yab in tomnal qui bats’u i pil ujnamtalab.
Tam am bichou in lej tomolnal a Pablo ani a Silas. Ma an ts’ejcom cauchic in aba’ an cau ca c’ot’inchat in toltomil ani ca huipiyat c’al i huithaxte’.
Tam ti lej huipiyamejits, tam ti baliyatchic al an huic’axte’. Uchan am beletnom huic’axte’ quin lej alhua’ beletna’chic.
Cum antsana’ ti uchanits, in ne’tha’ quin c’uajba’ ma tin lej luputhtal an huic’axte’. Taja’ jilc’onchic mats’q’uichiquinchithits in acan c’al i catmachic te’.
Tam ti ts’ejel acal u ol a Pablo ani a Silas ani in ajatnanchal im bij a Dios. Ani c’al patal an huic’nel u ots’ohuiyab.

Tam jun jic’tohual lej t’elelats an tsabal, ma yatsitslats in cub an huic’axte’. Tameq’ui tala’ japq’uin an hui’lebchic, ani tala’ huilts’onchat an huic’nelchic an calaniyo pat’al axi c’al ti huic’ath.

Ejtsin am beletnom huic’axte’ ani in tsu’u tala’ japq’uithits an hui’lebchic ti al an huic’axte’. In jixa’ in cutsilal abal quin cuete’ tsemtha’ tim ba’, cum in tsalpay abal tala’ pit’c’onenequits an huic’nelchic.
Tam thajat tauna c’al a Pablo antse’: ―Yab ca t’aja’ antsana’ ca othna’ ta ba’. Patal huahua’ teje’ u c’uajate.
Tamna’ am beletnom huic’axte’ in conchi i tajablab, ani jun athic otscan jun ti c’uajat a Pablo ani a Silas. C’al in inictal lej t’elelelits, in tuthlu in c’ua’lal tin acanchic.
Tam am beletnom huic’axte’ in ne’tha’chic eleb, ani in conoy: ―¿Pay’lomchic, jant’o cu t’aja’ abal quin jec’ontha c’al u hualab?
Tam toc’tsiyat c’al a Pablo ani c’al a Silas antse’: ―Ca bela’ an Ajatic Jesucristo ani jaja’ ne’ets ti jec’ontha’. Antsana’ ta ca jec’ontha jaye ax ta q’uima’.
Tam a Pablo ani a Silas in olnanchale in cahuintal a Dios ani patal ax tin q’uima’.
Aba ani’ pel i huat’ath ts’ejel acalits, bel am beletnom huic’axte’ in t’acchi a Pablo ani a Silas xan ti ts’ojbenec c’al an huithaxte’. Tamna’ pujan, ani jaye patal ax tin q’uima’.
Taley ne’thachic a Pablo ani a Silas c’al am beletnom huic’axte’ tin q’uima’, ani pijchinchic. Ani lej culbel jaja’ c’al patal ax tin q’uima’, cum in junax belamalitschic a Dios.
Tam ti thaju an ts’ejcom cauchic in aba’ ca c’ale an yac’ualchic quin ucha’ am beletnom huic’axte’ quin hualca’its a Pablo ani a Silas.
Tam uchan a Pablo c’al am beletnom huic’axte’: ―Tin abchi an cau an ts’ejcom cauchic abal nan tu hualca’chic. Xo’ quit calejitschic ani quit c’ale c’al a ichich jun ejet c’al a Dios.

Tam a Pablo in ucha’chic an yac’ualchic: ―Huahua’ pel tu lej aticlab cuentalith Roma, ani yab u t’ajchinenec an ts’ejcaxtalab jant’ini’ ti pel i uchbil. Expith u huipiyame c’al i huithaxte’ tin tsu’ux hual am bichou ani u baliyame al an huic’axte’. Ani xo’ an ts’ejcom cauchic in le’ abal cu tsinat hualca. Iba. Ca putat chich jaja’chic tucu hualca’. Tam ojni’ ne’ets cu c’ale.
Huichiy an yac’ualchic c’al an ts’ejcom cauchic, in olchi jant’ini’ tin ulu a Pablo. Ani jiq’uelchic tam tin exla’its abal Pablo ani a Silas pel i lej aticlab cuentalith Roma.
Tam c’alechic quin conchi a Pablo ani a Silas ca paculanchat. Taley in caltha’chic jun ti c’uajat, ani in lej pacabethach ucha’ abal ca calejits al nixe’ xi bichou.
Taley calejitschic ti al an huic’axte’, c’ale tin q’uima’ a Lidia. Taja’ in lubachmethanchalchic in ichich an ebchalabchic c’al jahua’ in t’iloxnalchic. Tamna’ tixc’anchic taja’.
